prog=open(p+'/task-d4b57c28.py','w')
prog.write('''from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    bars=[]; scattered=[]
    byrow={}
    for i,j in cells: byrow.setdefault(i,[]).append(j)
    for i,js in byrow.items():
        js=sorted(js); runs=[]; s=js[0]; p=js[0]
        for j in js[1:]:
            if j==p+1: p=j
            else: runs.append((s,p)); s=p=j
        runs.append((s,p))
        long=[r for r in runs if r[1]-r[0]+1>=2] if i in (0,H-1) else []
        if long:
            for r in long: bars.append((i,r))
            scattered.extend((i,j) for j in js if not any(r[0]<=j<=r[1] for r in long))
        else:
            scattered.extend((i,j) for j in js)
    L=len(scattered)
    scols=[j for i,j in scattered]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    col=g[scattered[0][0]][scattered[0][1]]
    for i,j in scattered: out[i][j]=4
    for (ri,(c0,c1)) in bars:
        if abs(c0-max(scols))<=abs(c1-min(scols)):
            bc=list(range(c0,min(c0+L,W)))
        else:
            bc=list(range(max(c1-L+1,0),c1+1))
        for b in bc:
            rng=range(1,H) if ri==0 else range(H-2,-1,-1)
            for rr in rng:
                if g[rr][b]!=bg: break
                out[rr][b]=col
    return out
''')
